description:
[narrowed from route-edit-b8e133f0] investigate and decompose gap route-edit-cc6568d8: repos/discovery-vessel/src/index.ts forwardToPeers (:62-96) discards every per-peer outcome: `if (!res.ok) return` (:84) destroys the HTTP status and `catch { }` (:94) destroys the error class, so a misconfigured or unreachable peer produces a response BYTE-IDENTICAL to no peers configured. The union merge (:272-297, predicate :284-291) additionally collapses three distinct drop causes

- verify_failed: src/index.ts(282,27): error TS2339: Property 'length' does not exist on type '{ vessels: Record<string, unknown>[]; peerStatuses: Record<string, { ok: boolean; status?: number | undefined; error?: str

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.
